system.description:
DISCIPLE MYSTIC STANCE

You enter the stance of a wolf, low to the ground with your hands held like fanged teeth. Your attacks deal piercing damage whilst in this stance and you gain the effects of the Pack Attack creature ability.

Automated: press Use to enter the stance: 1 AP, under the system's stance rules (one stance at a time, or two with Stance Mastery; Reactive Stance enters it free at initiative). It lasts until you enter another stance or delete its effect. While in it: your unarmed attacks (fists, gauntlets, Monastic weapons) deal piercing damage, without asking (Graham's B6-1), and you have Pack Attack: +1d6 precision damage when at least two of your allies threaten the target.
